result.rationale: The diff shows TopicEmbed.import creates posts with cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html], and Post#cook returns raw unmodified for that method, so feed-supplied HTML (PollFeed reads an arbitrary RSS feed's i.content and passes it to import) is persisted and rendered via `raw post.cooked` in embed/best.html.erb with no sanitization. Any script injected into the polled feed's content executes for embed viewers. The mechanism is verifiable in the diff; whether it's exploitable depends on trusting the feed source, so moderate confidence.

record.issue_text: app/models/topic_embed.rb:22 — Feed-supplied HTML is persisted with the raw_html cook method, so an untrusted feed entry can store executable markup and XSS every topic viewer.

adjudication.rationale: The diff shows that in app/models/topic_embed.rb line 22, PostCreator is called with `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]`, which according to app/models/post.rb lines 131-133 means `return raw` - the raw HTML is stored directly without sanitization. The content comes from external RSS/ATOM feeds (app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb) or remote URLs (import_remote method). The only processing is CGI.unescapeHTML and absolutize_urls, neither of which sanitize for XSS. This allows untrusted feed content containing malicious scripts to be stored and rendered to users, creating a stored XSS vulnerability.
